message:
The users API test passes now, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. That mismatch caused the "unknown column users.full_name" error. I changed the API to use `fullname` in both `createUser` and `getUser`, and left `migrations/` alone. The only modified file is `src/api/users.js`.
